issue_title: Credentials can reach a different host after a redirect
issue_body: When a request follows a redirect that points to a different host, sensitive headers from the original request are sometimes sent to the new host instead of being removed. Requests that follow a redirect to the same host are not affected.
prompt: When a request follows a redirect that points to a different host, sensitive headers from the original request are sometimes sent to the new host instead of being removed. Requests that follow a redirect to the same host are not affected.
expected_behavior: Object-form headers have authorization, cookie, and proxy-authorization stripped on cross-origin redirect.
Array-form header stripping behavior is unchanged.
Same-origin redirects do not strip those headers.
Non-sensitive headers are forwarded on all redirects.
